I am an old woman and I have no schooling, so I farm these cashew trees the way my mother taught me many years ago. My children and grandchildren help me weed under the trees and pick the nuts when the season comes, but we have no money to buy chemical fertilizers or sprays from the shop. We leave the trees in God's hands and depend on the rains He sends to Mtwara.
